nom: BLUME Blume Buds Power Patches for Acne-Prone Skin

segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin says she reaches for these patches often and they never disappoint.
segments.dry: One reviewer with dry skin found the patches worked well overnight without drying her skin further, though she notes results might differ on oily skin.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers describing sensitive skin report the patches felt gentle, hydrating and non-irritating rather than triggering reactions.
segments.mature: Two reviewers mention mature or 40+ skin and say the patches work well and are more discreet/cute than older options they associate with younger skin.

concerns.spots: Most reviewers report individual spots/pimples visibly flattened, reduced in size, or gone by morning after overnight use; a few say the patch stuck but the pimple was unchanged the next day.
concerns.blemishes: Many describe blemishes looking smaller, less noticeable, or with visible gunk extracted onto the patch after overnight wear; some report no visible extraction, especially on smaller pimples.
concerns.redness: Numerous reviewers report visibly reduced redness and calmer-looking skin around treated spots overnight.
concerns.oiliness: One reviewer credits the patches with absorbing excess oil in addition to healing breakouts.
concerns.barrier: Several reviewers highlight the patches as gentle and non-irritating even on sensitive or reactive skin, with no drying or stinging reported.

aspects.libelle: Patch fails to stick or slides off
Clear version wearable during the day

extraits.titre: So hard to get a pimple patch wrong
extraits.texte: I've had lackluster pimple patches before (Pacifica) but even those at least stuck they were just thin and easy to move around. So many brands have pimple patches now. I feel like it's hard to mess them up but Blume managed to do it. These don't stick. I put them on a cleansed, dry face. No skincare under because I'm worried about irritating the skin. Well even in those conditions this slides around. Like even when I put it on it seemed to slide to the side. Don't waste your money.

I thought these patches worked really well! I've tried tons of different acne patches. These ones are thin, but they don't have that cheap sticker quality that some other brands do where you fee like it's just covering the pimple without actually treating it. These stuck to my skin well. Make sure you're using it on freshly cleaned skin, otherwise you will have issues with it sticking. I also have dry skin, so it might be different on oily skin. But when I take them off in the morning, my acne looks smaller and more healed, and I can actually see the removed gunk on the patch. They're also cute and I think it's a great quantity for the price!

extraits.titre: Blume buds are my go to!
extraits.texte: Blume buds are my go to! I often get breakouts, and every time I feel a pimple coming on I use one of these patches and it heals within a couple of days! Not to mention they are so cute, I can even wear them in public! I use these both day and night. I love that I can look cute while having acne fighting power on my face at the same time. I have oily skin so I reach for these often, and they never disappoint! Absolutely love
LOVE these patches! I have super sensitive skin and these were so perfect- felt hydrated, healed and protected after using them! Best patches in the business you HAVE to check them out < 3
Perfect for my mature skin and my teenagers young skin. Lightweight with no residue and stays on all night

These pimple patches come in a pack of 24. Twelve of them are purple flower shaped and the other 12 are transparent flower shaped. They contain hydrocolloid and salicylic acid to dry the pimple. Ever since getting these patches, I haven't gotten any big juicy pimple. I tried them on my small pimples. I wore them overnight, but in the morning, the pimple was still intact. The patch did stick on well all night long. They didn't absorb the gunk in the pimple probably because the pimple was small. I would need to try these patches when I get bigger pimples to see how well they dry them out.
Not amazed by these. They worked at diminishing pimiples about half the time for me. With that and the price point, i dont feel its worth repurchasing.
